credits.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
credits.overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

credits.title: April
credits.overview: Set to a vibrant landscape, 'April' follows the emotional up-and-down journey of a full-of-life high school girl, named April (played by Celine Alva), as she navigates change, friendships, and ultimately a decision that could permanently alter her life.

credits.title: Silent Partners
credits.overview: In 1980s Miami, Valentine, a psychotic hitman seeks freedom by hijacking the Chicago Outfit's insurance scam. Partnering with enemies and pursued by a justice-driven undercover cop, a silent collaboration may be more deadly than lucrative.

credits.title: Stay Out
credits.overview: A group of friends on spring break driving through rural Florida breakdown in a mysterious, seemingly racist town where people are disappearing and returning as mind-controlled zombie slaves with an insatiable thirst for blood.

credits.title: Out
credits.overview: A moving drama that explores a father/daughter relationship after her coming out.

credits.title: Brass Knuckles
credits.overview: Two brothers separated by two worlds.

credits.title: Sick Minded
credits.overview: Special agent Martinez investigates a string of missing girls in south Florida, but when one of the victims is the Ambassador's daughter, the pressure rises in finding the kidnapper before it's too late.

credits.title: The Blonde Hair Murders
credits.overview: Private Investigator Daniel Benito has the arduous task of attempting to solve the case of several blonde girls, all the while dealing with his own personal dilemma of losing his wife, after sleeping with his co-worker. credits.title: Summer of my Discontent
credits.overview: Ella didn't believe in true love. But the summer before high school, love came looking for her; forcing Ella to decide whether to accept it or turn her back on a chance for true happiness.

credits.title: Middle School: The Worst Years of My Life
credits.overview: A quiet teenage artist Rafe Katchadorian has a wild imagination and is sick of middle school and the rules that have been put before him. Rafe and his best friend Leo have come up with a plan: break every rule in the school hand book and as you expect trouble follows.
